when using a <color=#ff9900>hot spring ticket</color> to enter the baths. Moreover, 
<color=#ff9900>recovery might be supercharged</color> when fatigued, increasing 
stats and allowing energy to recover past the usual bounds!
63.333: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.334:
In this scenario, the horsegirls' shared goal of achieving <color=#ff911c>victory
at the Breeder's Cup</color> takes precedence over other desires!
They'll have only one chance, on the <color=#ff911c>first half of November 
during the senior year</color>. Join the team members in this campaign 
of victory and mutual inspiration!
63.335:
Work hand in hand with your <color=#ff911c>team</color> to achieve a victory 
at the Breeder's Cup. <color=#ff911c>You will need every member if you 
are to take home first place there</color>, so train as one and 
become ever stronger, as a team!
63.336:
In <color=#ff911c>Strategy Meetings</color> there are 3 different <color=#ff911c>team stats you 
can upgrade</color> using <color=#ff911c>DP</color>. These stats will <color=#ff911c>affect the bonuses 
you get from DREAMS Training</color>! DP <color=#ff911c>cannot be reallocated</color>
later, so choose carefully!
63.337:
During the summer camp, <color=#ff911c>team members' dream gauge 
will rise every turn</color>. It's a great chance to increase
their rank, so keep an eye on that gauge!
63.338:
Trainer information can be viewed and set here. You can 
expect special comments from the active home screen 
horsegirl on your <color=#ff9900>birthday</color>, and some scenario content 
might change depending on your <color=#ff9900>gender</color>. 
(Gender can be changed at any time)
63.340:
You can select the Star Horsegirl and support 
card of the friends you <color=#ff9900>follow</color> from each list in training. 
You also earn more Friend Pt by helping a <color=#ff9900>mutual follower</color> 
to train. If you don't have many followers, try looking 
in the <color=#ff9900>recommendations</color>.
63.341:
Create your own <color=#ff9900>Trainer Card</color>, and share it as an image on 
social media. Show your info along with horsegirl, support and 
<color=#ff9900>customizable graphics</color>.
63.343:
You can procure <color=#ff9900>up to 10 Legacy-only Horsegirls per day</color>.
Just like in a Career, these horsegirls can develop various
traits based on support cards used and races entered.
63.344:
Use <color=#ff9900>Procurement</color> to obtain and save <color=#ff9900>Legacy-only Horsegirls</color>. 
These horsegirls can't participate in races or the Stadium, 
but their legacies can be inherited when starting a Career.
Make good use of these to train strong horsegirls!
63.345:
You can configure <color=#ff9900>up to 10 Preferred Traits</color>. 
Obtaining these will be prioritised.
63.346:
Use <color=#ff9900>Procurement</color> to obtain and save <color=#ff9900>Legacy-only Horsegirls</color>. 
These horsegirls can't participate in races or the Stadium, 
but their legacies can be inherited when starting a Career.
Additionally, these horsegirls will disappear when transferred
and cannot be restored.
63.349:
After obtaining a score, you can enter your trainee in separate 
rankings <color=#ff9900>grouped by horsegirl</color> to obtain a <color=#ff9900>special title</color>!
※ Only one horsegirl can enter in the rankings.
※ You can change your choice once within the allotted period.
63.350:
The BC race selected as your <color=#ff911c>ultimate goal</color> will affect which 
races you and your trainee will enter on the way there.
Goals matching her aptitudes are marked <color=#ff911c>"Recommended!"</color>,
so use that as your guide should you feel lost!
63.351:
Training with your team members means <color=#ff911c>more stats for you</color>
and a <color=#ff911c>rising dream gauge for them</color>. When a member's gauge
is <color=#ff911c>filled</color> after having risen thrice, <color=#ff911c>they will rank up</color> next time 
you train together! Seek out your team members in training 
whenever you can!
63.352:
Your team rank is based on the members with the <color=#ff911c>lowest rank</color>.
Higher team rank confers a <color=#ff911c>Friendship Bonus and other positive 
effects</color>. Team rank is also an important part of <color=#ff911c>Reviews</color>, so don't
just focus on a few members, <color=#ff911c>keep everyone's ranks high</color>!
63.353:
As you progress, <color=#ff911c>DREAMS Training</color> will become available.
When activating DREAMS Training, <color=#ff911c>all 3 team members and up 
to 5 supports from your deck will appear on all training facilities</color>!
You have a limited number of activations, and while Reviews
will recover these, <color=#ff911c>there's a limit</color> to how many you can have!
63.354:
Throughout your Career, 5 <color=#ff911c>Review</color> events will take place, 
and each one <color=#ff911c>demands a certain minimum Team Rank</color>.
The results will determine <color=#ff911c>how much DP</color> you can use
in the Strategy Meeting and the <color=#ff911c>rewards</color> you get.
Pay attention to your Team Rank!
63.355:
In <color=#ff911c>Strategy Meetings</color> there are 3 different <color=#ff911c>team stats you 
can upgrade</color> using <color=#ff911c>DP</color>. These stats will <color=#ff911c>affect the bonuses 
you get from DREAMS Training</color>! DP <color=#ff911c>cannot be reallocated</color>
later, so choose carefully!
63.356: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.357:
In Practice, you can freely hold races under <color=#ff9900>any conditions 
you want</color>. In addition to the Veterans you have trained, 
you can also run races with <color=#ff9900>other trainers' horsegirls</color>. 
You can hold practice with up to 18 horsegirls at once!
63.358:
If you see horsegirls you like in the Team Stadium, 
Room Match, or elsewhere, you can register them 
as <color=#ff9900>Training Partners</color> so that you can run friendly races 
together. The Star Horsegirls of the trainers you follow 
are also available.
63.359:
You can <color=#ff9900>share</color> your favorite <color=#ff9900>Veteran Horsegirls</color> with your 
Club and online. Actively register your Practice Partners 
from Club members and friends to enhance your practice!
63.360:
Save horsegirls in <color=#ff9900>My Entrants</color> to <color=#ff9900>select them easily</color> during 
registration! You can also save them from the results screen. 
Removing Training Partners will remove them from My Entrants 
as well, so be careful!
63.361: In Independent Training, after setting the training focus and race agenda and starting the Career, <color=#ff9900>the Career will automatically complete after a set amount of time has elapsed</color>.\nUnlike normal Career playthroughs, Independent Training has its own unique way of handling training and events that occur during the Career.
63.362: Independent Training is great to sneak in a Career playthrough when short on time. While waiting for Independent Training to complete, you can also return to the Home screen to read stories, participate in races, and <color=#ff9900>spend your time freely</color>!
63.363:
In cooperation with venues throughout the country,
Tracen's horsegirls bring ramen to race fans to thank
them for their constant support! Make time in your training
to research local ramen varieties and get that excitement
going at the end-of-year <color=#ff911c>Ramen Jamborees</color>!
63.364:
It's time to choose which regions' ramen to research over
the coming year! <color=#ff911c>Each year</color> you can choose <color=#ff911c>3 regions</color>, out
of a total of 10. The ramen and its <color=#ff911c>effects when prepared
differ</color> per region, so pay attention when selecting!
63.365:
To make ramen, first you need some expertise with its
constituents! Expertise comes in <color=#ff911c>3 groups</color>, and you can
hold <color=#ff911c>up to 10</color> at a time. You'll <color=#ff911c>gain 1 expertise</color> when its
<color=#ff911c>associated gauge is filled</color>. These gauges will <color=#ff911c>increase by
a set amount every turn</color>, based on your actions.
63.366:
With the gathered expertise, you can hold <color=#ff911c>Taste Tests</color> for
each region's ramen at <color=#ff911c>any time</color>. These will confer <color=#ff911c>various
bonuses</color> during that turn only. You will also gain <color=#ff911c>Excitement
Points</color> from Taste Tests, which will <color=#ff911c>influence your Ramen
Jamborees</color>, so don't be afraid to taste that ramen!
63.367: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.368:
It's time to choose which regions' ramen to research over
the coming year! <color=#ff911c>Each year</color> you can choose <color=#ff911c>3 regions</color>, out
of a total of 10. The ramen and its <color=#ff911c>effects when prepared
differ</color> per region, so pay attention when selecting!
63.369:
With the gathered expertise, you can hold <color=#ff911c>Taste Tests</color> for
each region's ramen at <color=#ff911c>any time</color>. These will confer <color=#ff911c>various
bonuses</color> during that turn only. You will also gain <color=#ff911c>Excitement
Points</color> from Taste Tests, which will <color=#ff911c>influence your Ramen
Jamborees</color>, so don't be afraid to taste that ramen!
63.370:
<color=#ff911c>Special seasonings</color> obtainable from <color=#ff911c>special events</color> can be
used to <color=#ff911c>fill in for missing expertise</color> when preparing ramen!
However, you can <color=#ff911c>only hold 4</color> of these, and <color=#ff911c>use 2 per Taste
Test</color>, so manage them carefully!
63.371:
<color=#ff911c>Every year after late december</color>, new knowledge is turned
into plans for the new year, and <color=#ff911c>gathered Expertise will
be reset</color>! Any <color=#ff911c>remaining expertise</color> lost this way is <color=#ff911c>converted
into energy</color>. Remaining <color=#ff911c>special seasonings will not reset</color>,
so plan wisely!
63.372:
A <color=#ff911c>Ramen Jamboree</color>, or <color=#ff911c>RMJ</color> for short, are events where
horsegirls can put all their gained ramen skill and knowledge
on display for attendees! A bigger <color=#ff911c>Turnout</color> increases not only
the fun, but your trainee's growth as well!
63.373:
You'll <color=#ff911c>gain 2 special seasonings</color> at the start of summer
camp, and <color=#ff911c>1 more every turn</color>! The summer is a perfect
time to enjoy ramen and Taste Tests' effects on training!
63.61: It's time for Tracen Academy's grand cultural festival, the Solefall Faire. Shinko Windy is planning a haunted house with her classmates, but her wild attitude threatens to scare the others away. With some focused on training for the fall racing season and others on the simple joys of youth, can this band of colorful personalities navigate the festival craze?
63.253:
Save your favorite settings under <color=#ff9900>My Race Conditions</color> and load them
to easily host Room Matches!
You can also host matches with ease using conditions from upcoming race events via <color=#ff9900>Recommended Races</color>.
63.258:
The <color=#ff9900>UGE</color> is an evaluation test to assess a Mecha Umamusume's development.
It is held 5 times over 3 years, with ratings determined by your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>.
<color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color> increases based on the total Lv of all 5 research categories.
Since each period has a Lv cap, train in a balanced manner to efficiently raise your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>!
63.259:
When selecting training, <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> may appear at random!
Training with <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> grants bonus Research Lv gains,
boosts training effectiveness, and fills your Overdrive Gauge.
Furthermore, <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> are guaranteed to appear during Friendship Training!
63.260:
At the end of a UGE, you can allocate the <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color> you've earned
to tune your Mecha Umamusume.
Tuning can only be performed immediately following a UGE,
so plan ahead for the next six months of training when tuning.
63.261:
Filling the Overdrive Gauge to max allows you to activate <color=#ff9900>Overdrive</color>.
The effects of <color=#ff9900>Overdrive</color> vary depending on your tuning,
so be sure to choose the effects you need most!
63.262:
In <color=#ff9900>Tuning</color>, you enhance your Mecha Umamusume's performance by allocating <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color>
to the <color=#ff9900>Chips</color> installed in the Head, Chest, and Leg <color=#ff9900>Cores</color>.
Each chip boosts different training effects,
so choose wisely based on which stats you want to improve.
63.263:
The total amount of Mecha EN allocated to each core changes the <color=#ff9900>effects of Overdrive</color>.
Check the effect list and combine the bonuses you need
to tune an even more powerful Overdrive!
63.264:
Your results in the UGE will vary depending on your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>.
Taking the UGE with "Promising Signs" will earn you an <color=#ff9900>S Rank</color>,
resulting in significant Umamusume stat growth.
Higher evaluations also award more <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color>, so aim for that <color=#ff9900>S Rank</color>!
63.289: The Uma Jukebox lets you <color=#ff9900>change the background music</color> to any song you've unlocked. Select the jukebox from the menu on the right side of the screen to play songs anywhere you like, whether it's the Home screen, a Career scenario, or any other part of the game.
63.292:
When a Trainee Umamusume with an evolvable Inherited Skill reaches 3★ or higher talent bloom,
and acquires that skill's hint at the start of training,
her Inherited Skill will evolve into a powerful Inherited Evolved Skill upon completing training.
63.297:
With <color=#ff9900>Swipe Controls</color>, swipe anywhere on the screen
to move the camera, and pinch to zoom.
To reset the camera to its default position,
tap the <color=#ff9900>[Reset Camera] button</color> in the bottom-left corner.
63.298:
With <color=#ff9900>Gyro Controls</color>, you can move the camera
by rotating or tilting your device.
*Zoom and camera reset controls are
the same as in Swipe Controls.
63.303:
With <color=#ff9900>Swipe Controls</color>, swipe anywhere on the screen
to move the camera, and pinch to zoom.
To reset the camera to its default position,
tap the <color=#ff9900>[Reset Camera] button</color> in the bottom-left corner.
63.304:
With <color=#ff9900>Gyro Controls</color>, you can move the camera
by rotating or tilting your device.
*Zoom and camera reset controls are
the same as in Swipe Controls.
63.313:
In the <color=#ff9901>Archives</color>, you can challenge limited-time races
previously featured in Master's Challenge at any time.
Your previous clear status will carry over.
*Limited-time races will be added to the Archives sequentially.
63.314:
With the Trainer Notebook, you can <color=#ff9900>skip</color> content like Daily Races and Team Stadium!
You can also <color=#ff9900>skip multiple activities at once</color>.
Set your <color=#ff9900>Skip Policy</color> and enjoy playing through various content with ease!
63.329:
<color=#ff9900>Uncap Crystals</color> can be exchanged for Support Cards that can be uncapped.
Exchanged Support Cards will automatically undergo <color=#ff9900>Limit Break</color>.
Cannot be exchanged for unowned Support Cards or Support Cards that are already fully uncapped.
63.330:
In the <color=#ff9900>Pretty Derby Scout</color>, you can obtain Trainee Umamusume and pieces.
If you pull an <color=#ff9900>already-owned Trainee Umamusume</color>,
she will be converted into <color=#ff9900>Goddess Statues based on her ★ rarity</color>.
63.331:
In the <color=#ff9900>Support Card Scout</color>, you can obtain Support Cards.
If you pull an <color=#ff9900>already-owned Support Card</color>,
it will automatically undergo <color=#ff9900>Limit Break</color>.
63.339:
By setting a <color=#ff9900>Representative Umamusume</color> and <color=#ff9900>Support Card</color>,
you can assist your followers with their training.
You will receive <color=#ff9900>Trainer Medals</color> and <color=#ff9900>Friend Pt</color> the next day based on usage count.
(Sent to your Presents box)
63.342:
You can also <color=#ff9900>share to social media</color> your Representative Umamusume's <color=#ff9900>Factor Info</color>,
as well as your <color=#ff9900>secondary Representative Umamusume and Training Supports</color>.
Show off your proudest Umamusume with the Business Card feature!
63.347:
Reach the top rankings in the Main Stage to earn <color=#ff9900>Exclusive Titles</color> based on your final rank!
Fight your way through high-level races and aim for the top!
63.348:
Trainers who finish ranked 1st through 96th in the Main Stage
will have <color=#ff9900>Special Prizes</color> shipped directly to them!
Eligible Trainers will see an entry banner on the Home screen
after the event concludes, so please check there for details.
63.374:
Spend dedicated <color=#ff911c>Ability Pt</color> to activate <color=#ff911c>Trainer Abilities</color>
with various helpful training effects for a <color=#ff911c>set duration</color>.
Activate abilities tailored to your training goals
and raise your Umamusume effectively!
63.378: Choose between a manual Career playthrough and Independent Training via the tabs on the final confirmation screen!
63.383:
Ability Pt can be obtained from the Training Pass and various events.
Additionally, purchasing the Premium Pass for the Training Pass
will allow you to earn even more Ability Pt.

69.8001: If your trainee can't run very fast during the final spurt,\nshe might be lacking Speed.
69.8002: If your trainee often falls in rank near the end of the race,\nshe might be lacking Stamina.
69.8003: If your trainee is having trouble getting to the front,\nyou might want to work on her Power.
69.8004: If your trainee can't keep up during the final stretch,\nshe might be lacking Guts.
69.8005: With high Wit, your trainee will find it easier to position herself\nand make use of skills.
69.8006: You should enter in Daily Races if you want to acquire more monies or Support Points.
69.8007: Strengthening your Support Cards and Umamusume are vital to winning races.
69.8008: The outcome of a race can be affected by the weather, how the field runs,\nand at times even sheer luck.
69.8009: Increasing the level of Support Cards makes their effects more powerful.
69.8010: Uncapping Support Cards and leveling them up further\nwill unlock more powerful effects.
69.8011: Mood Effect will also amplify the effects of negative moods, so be careful!
69.8012: Friendship Bonus makes Friendship Training even more beneficial.
69.8013: Speed Bonus and other attribute bonus effects make\ntheir relevant trainings more effective.
69.8014: Training Effectiveness makes all training more effective,\nregardless of type.
69.8015: Initial Speed and similar effects let you begin a Career\nplaythrough with higher attributes.
69.8016: Initial Friendship Gauge comes in handy when\nyou want to build friendship earlier.
69.8017: Race Bonus and Fan Bonus also apply to goal races.
69.8018: Race Bonus helps you obtain more skill points.
69.8019: Hint Levels increases the level of hints given to your trainee.
69.8020: Hint Frequency makes hint events occur more often.
69.8021: Specialty Priority helps a support character appear\nin their preferred training more often.
69.8022: Event Recovery increases the amount of Energy gained from events.
69.8023: Event Effectiveness increases the beneficial effects gained from events.
69.8024: Failure Protection makes it harder to fail Training with that support character.
69.8025: Energy Cost Reduction makes training consume less Energy\nwhen performed with that support character.
69.8026: Wit Friendship Recovery increases the amount of Energy gained\nfrom Wit Friendship Training.
69.8027: Friendship Training becomes available after a Friendship Gauge turns orange.
69.8028: Friendship Training is even more effective when multiple instances trigger at once.
69.8029: When you slot a Support Card in your deck, events associated\nwith that card will be more likely to occur.
69.8030: Events of Support Cards not in your deck can still occur.
69.8031: Keep in mind that you cannot use a Support Card\nof the Umamusume you are training.
69.8032: You can trade in Support Cards you don't want for Cleats,\nwhich can be exchanged for items in the shop.
69.8033: You can check what skill hints you can get from a Support Card in its "Career events" section.
69.8034: You can increase the Potential level of a trainee\nwith monies and various items.
69.8035: The higher an Umamusume's Potential level, the more skills\nshe gets at the start of a Career playthrough.
69.8036: Items that increase Potential level can be obtained by placing 1st in\nG3 or higher races in Career.
69.8037: Collecting enough Star Pieces of an Umamusume will allow you to perform Star Unlock.
69.8038: Performing Star Unlock on an Umamusume will improve her attributes\nand increase the level of her Unique Skill.
69.8039: Increasing an Umamusume to 3★ or higher will unlock her signature racewear.
69.8040: You can trade in unneeded Star Pieces for Clovers,\nwhich can be exchanged for other items in the shop.
69.8041: Veteran Umamusume can grant inspiration as Legacies\nand participate in Team Trials or other races.
69.8042: Note that when you transfer a Veteran Umamusume, she cannot return.
69.8043: The rating given at the end of a Career playthrough is calculated based on\nparameter totals and skills acquired.
69.8044: Veteran Umamusume can obtain Sparks corresponding to what they\nlearned and accomplished during their careers.
69.8045: Sparks have different rarities.\nThe more ★ a Spark has, the greater its effect.
69.8046: The more a trainee accomplishes during her career,\nthe more Sparks she can get.
69.8047: Some Sparks activate their effects during the Inspiration event\nat the start of a Career playthrough.
69.8048: Attribute Sparks will improve your trainee's parameters when activated.
69.8049: Aptitude Sparks will increase track, distance, and style aptitudes.
69.8050: Skill Sparks will increase skill hint levels.
69.8051: Race Sparks will increase parameters and skill hint levels.
69.8052: When a Spark for a skill your trainee has already acquired activates, stats will increase instead.
69.8053: Legacy Umamusume can continue to grant inspiration\nin as many Career playthroughs as you like.
69.8054: Legacy Umamusume can be borrowed from friends using monies.
69.8055: When selecting a Legacy Umamusume, their affinity with your trainee is shown by ◎＞○＞△, from highest to lowest.
69.8056: Classmates, roommates, and family members will naturally\nhave a higher affinity with each other.
69.8057: You get a discount when borrowing a Legacy Umamusume from a fellow Club member.
69.8058: You might learn something by checking the Career info of your friends' Star Umamusume.
69.8059: When Rushed, a runner panics and loses endurance.\nHigher Wit can help prevent this.
69.8060: The better a runner is at navigation, the easier she can weave\nthrough rivals blocking her way.
69.8061: Speed is particularly important for sprint races.
69.8062: Speed and Power are crucial for mile races.
69.8063: A good balance of attributes is critical for medium races.
69.8064: Stamina and Guts are key for long races.
69.8065: A runner's predicted performance is rated in the paddock\nwith ◎>○>▲>△ from highest to lowest.
69.8066: Going out for some recreation can improve your trainee's Mood and recover Energy.
69.8067: You might be able to cure a harmful condition by enjoying recreation\nat a shrine with your trainee.
69.8068: I wonder if something might happen after the URA Finale if your bond\nwith Reporter Otonashi is strong enough...
69.8069: It might be easier to receive inspiration from Legacies \nwho have strong affinity with your trainee.

69.8071: Information related to Umamusume is displayed on the school\nbulletin board on the Home screen.
69.8072: Sprint races are 1400m or shorter, and mile races are between 1401m and 1800m.
69.8073: Medium races are between 1801m and 2400m long. Long races are over 2401m long.
69.8074: Rain or snow can cause track conditions to worsen from Firm to Good, then Soft,\nand finally Heavy, making it harder to run.
69.8075: Races are divided into levels. From lowest to highest,\nthese are: Pre-OP < OP < G3 < G2 < G1.
69.8076: The higher the level classification of a race, the stronger the runners.
69.8077: G1, G2, and G3 races are called graded races, with G1 being the highest rank.
69.8078: A trainee can obtain a Spark for her Unique Skill if she is 3★ or higher.
69.8079: Racecourses for the URA Finale are chosen based on your trainee's\nmost frequent race destinations during her career.
69.8080: The Senior Spring Triple Crown refers to the following three races:\nthe Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen.
69.8081: The Triple Tiara refers to the following three races:\nthe Oka Sho, Japanese Oaks, and Shuka Sho.
69.8082: The Senior Autumn Triple Crown refers to the following three races:\nthe Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen.
69.8083: The Classic Triple Crown refers to the following three races:\nthe Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho.
69.8084: If you don't want to accidentally skip over unread events,\nyou can change the settings in your Options.
69.8085: If you use Star Pieces, you can unlock new trainees\neven if you haven't scouted them.
69.8086: Growth Rate makes it easier for a trainee to improve their attributes.
69.8087: The higher the hint level of a skill, the less skill points you need to acquire it.
69.8088: In races such as Team Trials and Room Matches, your opponents' skill activations will be visible as well. You can disable this feature in the Options menu if you prefer.

At first, it was because of her lineage, of course. Tracen has a lot of talented heiresses from racing families, but her grandmother was an Oaks winner, and her mother was an undefeated Oka Sho winner, so I could understand the extra curiosity.

But the attention on her quickly became due to other reasons. Her behavior was eccentric and her experiments suspicious, yet despite it all, her talent was undeniable. Anyway, my point is, you can understand why people would want to avoid her.

"Mwahaha! What a delightful thesis idea I've stumbled upon. I'll be breaking new ground on Umamusume muscle contractions and energy dynamics—why, I may even make this the topic of my next experiment! Heh, just kidding!"

She's at it again today, sitting in the corner of the busy cafeteria, surrounded by empty chairs. Perhaps there's an invisible barrier around her? Given the bizarre amount of sugar cubes she's stacked up, maybe she's performing a ritual to keep others away. Ordinary students like me couldn't hope to cross a barrier like that.

"Tachyon. You shouldn't play with your food."

"Oh, if it isn't Cafe! Well, that saying only applies if I am not utilizing food for its intended purpose, does it not? You see, I plan to put all of this sugar—yes, all of it—into my tea! Thus, since I will be consuming it, there is no—"

"Problem? I'm not convinced."

Apparently, there are many students who can cross that barrier these days.

Cafe passes by the empty chairs and sits across from Tachyon, sighing. As she does, a single sugar cube topples and falls off one of the unsteady towers.

and the warmth of the tea I drink.

chased away by those more vivid,

"Hop, skip! Skip, hop! ♪ I'll give it my all, like 'blaaam!'"

"...What kind of song are you singing?"

I walk up to her and ask a simple question. She looks like she's having so much fun, and her energy is infectious.

"Oh, it's my racewear song! I'm really looking forward to wearing it at my next race! I'll give it my all, like 'blaaaam!'"

She's singing because she's excited. And she's excited because she's going to run. Her explanation is so simple, but it resonates with me deeply.

"Good for you."

At some point, I forgot what it felt like to run for fun.

"Hey, do you wanna sing with me? Here, I'll count us in!"

"Whoa, r-right now?"

"A one, and a two! Hop, skip! Skip, hop! I'll give it my all! ♪"

"L-like 'blaaaam...'"

"Like 'blaaam!' Hehe, I can't wait for my next race!"

It's funny, I've only sung a single line with her, but I already feel a bit happier.

Right, races are supposed to be fun. There's no need to worry about the details. I just need to go out there and have fun!
88.30099:
Wow... Ikuno, you look so pretty... Just like a real bride!

"Thank you, Rice."

Wearing such splendid racewear in front of everyone... is making me surprisingly self-conscious. Still, this kind of opportunity doesn't come by every day. I just need to make it through this photo shoot...

"What?! Ikuno, you're getting married?! No way, since when?! I don't want you to gooo!"

"Huh? What're you doing, Turbo?! Look, you're getting in the shot, silly!"

"Nooo waaaaay! Don't leave me behiiind!"

Due to Turbo's misunderstanding, the photo shoot has been rendered into a state of mild disarray. That said, hearing the star front runner Turbo cry "Don't leave me behind!" is amusing in it's own way.

"Turbo, please calm down. I'm not going anywhere."

There's no way I'd leave now. After all, we're still in the middle of a race of our own.

Once we're done taking photos, I think I'll join Turbo and the others in their training.
88.30100:
Once upon a time, I went to a wedding.

When the bride smiled gently, the people around her also started smiling, and everyone was as happy as they could be. I'll always treasure that wonderful memory.

One day, I want to make everyone smile like that. I want to spread happiness to everyone around me. It's not much, but that's my dream.

I'll gather up my courage... and take that big step forwards. And once I do, I'll see smiles everywhere I look.

It'll be just like what the bride saw at that wedding—the sight of happiness. Up until now, I've only gotten a glimpse of that view.

"...I want to keep on making people smile."

I hope to keep on putting smiles on everyone's faces, so that someday, everyone can find their very own happiness.
88.30101:
Reckless.

For all her speed—so fast she seems to have surpassed light itself—she'll wear herself out before the finish line.

That is what everyone thinks. Yet she laughs, bound by her own spell.

"Ahh, how magnificent! How glorious! Be mine, sweet rapture!"

With reckless theories as her weapon, she dominates the track. To her, it feels as if the world has become more saturated, richer in color.

"Hehe. I wonder—what ecstasy awaits me in my next experiment?"

It is a feeling only she knows.
88.30102:
Dober's way too nice. She's always overthinking things and worrying about others.

Why do I know this? Because she's saved me so many times with her kindness and thoughtfulness!

"...Let the match begin!"

Entering the ring from the red corner, we have Tracen Academy's Phantom Bird—Masked El!

And in the blue corner, we have her opponent, Señorita Mejiro—Worrywart Dober!

The rules are simple! Listen to Dober, talk with her, and make her smile for a perfect ring out! ...Haha, I've got this one in the bag!

"After all, with this mask on, I'm pumped up, confident—invincible, even!"
88.30103:
In a picturesque forest, two Umamusume swing from a single vine, riding the wind.

"Um, Taiki?"

"What's up? Somethin' in your noggin?"

"There's something I've always wanted to try if I ever got into a situation like this... Well, more like say? Or even shout? Anyways, there's something!

"Roger that, Tannhauser! We're birds of a feather!"

"Right! Then, on three... One, two... three!

"Ahhhhh! ♪"
88.30104:
A water spirit's shoreline, a fairy's secret garden, and a door only revealed by starlight... After overcoming countless trials, the townspeople had finally reached their destination. And now, in front of them, was the most beautiful sight in the world...

"Well, I'll be! The walls are glowing baby blue!"

"It's like we've entered another world... Who knew a place like this existed?"

Faced with such a dreamlike scene, the townspeople could only open their mouths in awe and say...

"Ahhh, this is it! We've really entered the world of that story!"
88.30105:
To become the best racer in all of Japan.

That was my dream. It was my everything—what I'd promised to my moms.

Still, dreams are funny things, aren't they? I wanted to grab hold of mine, but like mist on a cold morning, no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't. All I could do was try my hardest—to keep on reaching for something that couldn't be reached.

But it was worth it.

All of my experiences—everyone I've met along the way—helped make my dreams come alive! I've had nail-biting races against my rivals, and I overcame hurdles inside of me that I thought I couldn't. There's been tough times, even sad times. But there's also been fun times and happy times. Everything I've been through has helped shape my dream!

Do you have a dream? Or maybe a burning desire? Then let's go chase it together! I'll help make your dreams come true!
88.30106:
If she wins this race, then both mother and daughter will have conquered the Japanese Oaks—an unheard-of feat. The venue is filled with both expectations and doubts, each weighing heavily on this one racer's shoulders.

But the moment the Empress takes to the turf, all the commotion is blown away in a burst of wind. For her, even the wind is but another of her subjects. She heads towards the starting gate with confident strides.

Her sharp eyes demand absolute fealty from all who face her. Her fingers clench into a fist so tight her nails dig into her skin.

She desires perfection. She hungers for victory. Her pride as Empress is her weapon.

"This race is mine for the taking."
88.30107:
Incoming weather report from your big sister Maruzensky. ♪

Today, my baby blue skies and wicked hot summer rays are going to shoot you through the heart, and I'm to blame! On the forecast: a frolic at the beach—don't forget to make a splash! ♪

But time flies when you're having fun, and we're looking at a chilly front rolling in with the sunset.

As for the evening, we can expect a dusting of localized sentimentality with just a dash of melancholy.

But don't fret, it's all A-OK! The sun's not the only thing that shines a light on me. I've got a totally hip-happenin' somebody who keeps the mood high and good times rolling. ♪

So enjoy that melancholy while you can, because tomorrow's nothing but a gentle, sunny day. ♪
88.30108:
This is what I want. This single, electrifying moment. As simple as I can get it, atop the greatest stage there is, with pinpricks of excitement and dread needling my skin. I wait for my opponents to up the ante.

My fate lies in the palm of their hand.

Then, the moment of truth.

In this single instant, we burn through all our luck. Flames burning bright before we flicker out.

Yeah. This is what I live for. As long as I've got moments like these...

"I couldn't quit if I wanted to."
88.30109:
"A good heart blossoms to its fullest."

(Source: A certain white-hot showdown)
Definition: Just as there are those who can run because they have someone they admire, one can also succeed by earnestly trying to support the person they admire.

(Commentary)
I was able to come this far because there's someone I look up to. So now, it's my turn to help her! I'm going to have fun, get fired up, and race her with everything I've got!
88.30110:
Welcome.

Back again, I see... Yes. I'll be working here for a while. To help out my dad.

You'll be having your usual black? Right awa—hmm? Milk? No, there's no problem. It's just... rare for you, is all.

Ah. A change of pace. I see... You sound... quite busy.

Um... I did say "right away," but could you... give me some time?

My dad's policy is to always cater to the customer, so... maybe I could make something just for you.

In what way? Well...

You'll just have to find out.
88.30111:
Whether it's a race or anything else, I'm always more excited than nervous in the face of a challenge.

People say it's because I'm brimming with curiosity, but that's not the only reason.

After I've overcome the challenge—once I'm past that finish line—there's this sparkly feeling that washes over me...

Even now, I can't wait for it to come. I can't help but wonder what lights are waiting for me once this race is won! So I'm gonna steer this thing like it's never been steered be—

"Her blue scarf trailing in the wind. ♪ She turns the wheel and the speed machine sings! ♪"

"Teio, oo! ♪ Teio, oo! ♪"

"Teio, oo, ooooo!"

"Aw, come on, Turbo! I was being all serious! Don't go making up some weird theme song for me!"
88.30112: Another day, another training session with Twin Turbo. She races around the track at top speed. "Huff... Huff... Pant..." But she's not pacing herself at all. With each lap, her pace slows. "Yo, Dual Booster! Isn't it about time for a break?" "It's Twin Turbo! And I'm doing one last lap, so Teio—time me!" "I mean, the harder I try, the faster I get! That's how it works in my games, too! No way I'm ever giving up!" "And if it's like my games, I haven't activated my unique skill yet! Let's go, Turbo Booooost!" Twin Turbo blazes away once more. Nevertheless, she quickly loses steam, and her running gets shaky. Still, the way she just keeps going, as though forward is the only direction she knows... "Man, she's so cool..."
88.30113:
Aircraft built of steel, soaring over the mountains.

Such a sight is commonplace in reality. All one needs to achieve it are aerodynamically sound blueprints and the right construction materials. But this place is different...

I've never seen these materials before, and apparently there are new laws of physics I need to catch up on.

I knew it. If I want to make this project a reality, I'll have to do further research on this world's underlying principles.

"Hmm... Is this material this world's version of titanium? And here we have a steam engine, one of the greatest firsts in technological history..."

"Oh? A communications device? An electromagnetic geo-transmitted power system? And a steam compression-based semi-perpetual motion device?"

"Wait, but that implies that this alloy's durability can withstand the pressure! Are you saying it's more durable than even tungsten?!"

"Yeah, uh, this is a fantasy setting. Pretty sure anything goes."
88.30114:
"These portraits are the pride of our house. A history of deeds achieved and honors bestowed."

A clear voice rings out from upon the elegantly styled landing. Portraits cover the wall from end to end, and a single girl stands before them. Her appearance is delicate, almost ephemeral, yet within her eyes is a cold, clear dignity.

"These are my mother and grandmother. Victors of many a race, and recipients of URA awards besides. Even among the history of our house, they stand tall and radiant."

White porcelain fingers trail through empty air. She holds a graceful right hand over the crimson ribbon upon her chest.

"Every member of our house strives to do the same—without exception."

Her words echo across the atrium.

The wall's countless eyes all gaze at the girl's back.
88.30115:
Halloween costume photo shoot time! Wahey! ☆ You're looking way grammable, Palmster! I'm gonna snap a few!

"Whoa! The set, the costume quality—this is the real deal! We're gonna have so much fun!"

"Say less, girl! You're killing that devil costume! A trillion points!"

What's the word for it again? Right, you're be-witching! The older sister look is totally your vibe, Palmster. ♪

"Now get ready, it's photo time! Give me your best devil impression!"

"Uh, impression? That's kinda embarrassing..."

"Girlboss, just send it! Pretend you've got greed on the mind and you're gonna take what you want!"

"Take, huh? Okay, I'll give it a shot!"

"Hey little snack, you're smelling kinda sweet. I think I'm gonna give you a little nibble... ♪"

Whoa, talk about a zap to my heart, Palmster! You can eat me right up, low-key! Aaand snap! That's one hella fire pic!

A smiling devil on a moonlit night. Major Halloween vibes, check!
88.30116:
Halloween costume photo shoot time! I'm gonna take some way grammable pics of you, Helios!

"Waheeey! Happy Halloween! ♪ How 'bout it? Is my angel drip legit or what?"

"Hehe, for sure! An upbeat style's the perfect match for you!"

I mean, you're always brightening up your surroundings and making the mood, like, wahey! You're the angel with the rizz!

Okay, give me whatever moves you've got! I'll follow you and snap some pics!

"Yo, no cap?! Then I'm gonna go hand out candy to everyone!"

"Wahey! ☆ Your angel's comin' through! Step right up if you want some candy! ♪"

I didn't see that one coming! You can always count on Helios to blast the vibes... Oh, this has gotta be the best pic.

A shining angel under the sun! Time for this Halloween party to get started!
88.30117:
[Windy's Demon Queen Castle Plan]

<Demon Queen Castle Concept>
It's Demon Queen Windy's Castle of Horror! All who enter meet a gruesome fate, falling into the depths of terror itself!

<Plan>

→ Super dark castle = super scary!

Once everyone's fallen into the depths of terror, the Demon Queen's army will reign supreme!!!
88.30118:
It's time.

With each step forward, the cheers, my footfalls, my heartbeat—they all fade. Yet...

My soul howls in anticipation. I've already had my fill of bitterness. All that's left...

"Is to bite down on my prey."
88.30119: There was regret. There was grief. There was contrition. But alongside it all, there were prayers for the generations to come. How noble, how magnificent our predecessors were. How sublime their caring hearts. "One day—and that day willcome—I will prove it to them." I will prove that all their prayers have reached us, here in the future, and are pushing us ever forward.
88.30120:
Heartfire Bearers Reignition Ceremony Practice

"You're incredible, Yaeno. You move like you don't feel the heat of the flames at all. I'd love to learn from your example—is there a secret I'm missing?"

"No, a novice such as I has nothing so grand. As strange as it may sound, it's simply that, when I dance, I do not feel the heat."

"I see. They do say that worldly sensations are but impermanences of the mind."

"If I truly have attained such mental focus, then I must be grateful. Hehe. I'd thought my single-minded nature was a bad habit, but I suppose it may also be a weapon, depending on one's viewpoint."

"I'm sure it is."

"In that case, I hereby swear on my name as Yaeno Muteki. Whether raging fire or wavering heart should bar my way, I shall fulfill my duty! Even should this body of mine be scorched by unrelenting heat, I shall remain steadfast and see my dance to completion!"

"Hehehe. Such inspiring spirit. But we can't have you being scorched, so let's practice dancing safely, all right?"

"...Right!"
88.30121:
Fan Appreciation Event Letter of Invitation

This is Mihono Bourbon, a member of the event committee. On behalf of all Umamusume, thank you for always supporting us.

All of us have reached where we are today by running toward the goals before us. However...

We were not alone. Not when our hearts were captured by the dreams we saw, nor when we lost hope when faced with insurmountable walls.

Your support was there with us. Each time we heard your encouragement, we rose to our feet and set our sights on new dreams.

The footprints we've left together with you will soon round the second corner.

To use racing as a metaphor, once the warm-up is complete, it becomes time to put all of one's preserved strength into one's legs and run.

As such, we will be holding a fan appreciation event to express our gratitude for the encouragement you've given to us, as well as to commemorate the long race ahead. You are cordially invited to participate.

Now, and in the future, we will continue to run alongside you, our irreplaceable fans.

"There! How does that sound?"

"Amazing... You removed all the stiffness without changing any of the content!"

"I agree with Suzuka. Conjecture posits that this invitation letter is sufficiently casual enough to entice fan participation. In short, it is, as they say, wonderful."

"Ehehehe! Still, it only came out so well because of the care you put into the original message, Bourbon! ♪ Now all that's left is to make sure everyone has fun on the day!"

"Yes. I simply, to use the common phrase, cannot wait."
88.30122: One, two, three-four-five, six-seven, eight, nine-ten. A metronome that strays is one that has failed in its duty. Tick, tick, tick—it carves time away in even intervals, without exception. Its beauty is my guide. I lend an ear to it, and thus I maintain equilibrium. And yet... One-two-three, four, five-six-seven, eight-nine, ten. My metronome has gone askew, but I do not correct it. I place it into the box of lost memories and close the lid. Deep emotion, the past, merriment, nostalgia, envy, tears, tenacity, again and again! They press on me from all sides! Like a miscalibrated clockwork toy, I cannot control their rhythm! Danke! Danke! Danke! All that remains is sheer, unbound joy. Danke! For I can find naught else to say!
88.30123:
"I didn't think you were capable of making a face like that."

Narita Brian's ears perk up at the sound of Air Groove's voice. She turns to its source, glaring at the gray-haired girl as if to say, "Got a problem?"

"I'm just saying the photo turned out wonderfully—it has a certain air of festive cheer to it. To be honest, I thought you weren't a fan of the holiday season, but it appears I was mistaken."

"Well, it's the one time of the year my sister won't nag me about how much meat I eat."

"Haha, I'm glad to hear it. Even Hayahide wouldn't go so far as to ruin the holidays, I see."

"Besides," Narita Brian whispers beneath her breath before looking up at the Furlong Tower.

"I don't mind festivities every once in a while."

"Well, it looks like you and I agree on something for once. I'm of the same opinion."

With the Furlong Tower flickering brightly before them, both Narita Brian and Air Groove sit in silence and watch the lights repeatedly blink on and off.
88.30124:
The day before the Tracen Academy winter holiday party, Air Groove asks Fuji Kiseki for some advice.

"Ahem... 'Happy holidays, everybody. I'd like to express my gratitude to you all for coming to Tracen Academy on this joyous occasion.' I was thinking about opening with that."

"Hm, I can tell that you're speaking from the heart—that's for sure! But it might be a bit too stuffy given the season."

"I had a feeling... But I can't help it when I'm speaking as a member of the student council..."

"Well, I guess it's true that you're always mindful of your surroundings! Then how about this? Pretend you're Santa Claus—act it out! 'Ho ho ho ho! Happy holidays!' Like that! Now you try!"

"What?! F-fine... "Heh heh heh! Happy holidays!" How's that?"

"Hm... Not quite! Less sinister, more silly!"

"Are you calling me evil?!"

"Hahaha! Yeah, like that! Just keep being expressive, Air Groove! I think that's a good starting point."

"Hm... Is that so? But I suppose you're right. My mother wouldn't approve of me like this. The holidays are meant to be a joyful season. And in order to create such an atmosphere, I must deliver a joyful message."

"Exactly! Hehe... I can't wait to hear your speech, Air Groove!"

"Of course. I promise to deliver."
88.30125:
I'm not going to ask for your thoughts.
Why? Because I put my all into my performance onstage.

I sang until my voice went hoarse.
Each of my moves had enough force to punch a hole in the ground.
I gave everything I had because I wanted you to notice me.

This is my message to you—a confession of my sincerest feelings.

"My dear Brian, I'd like you to join me on stage next time... as long as you stand to my side."
88.30126:
Though this race is a gathering of the fiercest GI winners, Yamanin Zephyr has yet to achieve any notable results.

It's only natural that she isn't garnering much attention.

But soon, people will know her name. They'll realize their mistake of overlooking this gentle gust.

"Hyaaaaah!"

The wind personified, Yamanin Zephyr starts by quickly breezing across the track.

By the fourth corner, she's already in third place. From there, she dashes straight into the lead.

Fast and free is the wind—more than anyone, and anything. This is the same wind I witnessed back then.

The howling tempest refuses to let anyone past it.

"So this is what it's like to become one with the wind... and what a calming breeze it is. But the wind continues to blow further on, so I too must continue to ride this current. The true wind lies at the end of this path—faster and more furious than all else."

She storms past the finish line and raises her right hand high towards the skies above.

At the same time, a fresh gust of wind blasts across the turf—a sure tell of the blessings to come.
88.30127:
"Hey, Spe. Do you know about the secret meaning behind hanetsuki?"

Grass asks me this as she raises a brush dripping with black ink towards my face.

"The secret meaning behind hanetsuki?"

"Well, the nut at the end of the birdie signifies good health. And the paddle is given as a gift during New Year's in hopes that the recipient will grow up to be healthy and beautiful. Basically, it wards off bad luck."

"Wow!"

"So hanetsuki was never meant to be a competitive game—you hit the birdie back and forth for good health!"

"Whoa, I never would've thought that! If that's how it is, then we gotta keep our rally going for as long as we can! ...Oh, Ms. Wonder! I have a question! Is there also a reason why we paint the loser's face with ink?"

"Great question, Special Week. Some theorize that the black ink was meant to ward off evil spirits, which made painting someone's face an act of protection from potential harm. That way, even if a feather falls off, you can simply paint your face to stay safe."

"So it's not just a punishment for losing! ...All righty!"

Special Week squeezes the brush in her hand and takes a deep breath.

"One large circle around your right eye so you can run all year without getting hurt. A diagonal line on your left cheek so you don't get sick. And another line on your left cheek to make an 'x' so you can eat lots of yummy food and laugh a whole bunch!"

"I put my well-wishes into every stroke, so let's keep running together as both rivals and friends—now and forever!"

"Thank you so much, Spe! Hehe, I think you used a bit too much ink though."

"Huh? Whoa! You're right—I'm so sorry!"
88.30128:
A young girl silently descends the snow-covered stairs. She hums, lace umbrella in hand and glossy tail swaying from side to side.

Suddenly, a photographer calls her name. She shakes her tail once more before turning around slowly—a breathtaking sight, indeed.

Her gorgeous face is covered by the umbrella's shadow. The passionate red against a pale white garners attention.

She gracefully rotates her neck, her eyes still trained behind her. Her hands are placed elegantly upon the handle, while the umbrella itself continues to envelop her figure.

The girl's beauty is jaw-dropping. Though clearly visible, her bewitching presence is almost ethereal, as if she could fade into thin air at any moment. 

For a second, our eyes meet. She smiles, appearing to be pleased.

"Hehe. Aren't I just perfect? As a great witch in training, I can take on any form I want! ♪"
88.30129:
One by one, in the moments before the break of dawn, the lanterns representing the many shrine maidens flicker to life.

The flames of faith spread—for those girls will surely see it through.

"They're beautiful..."

The gentle lights ward off the harsh winter cold of night. These pure souls, with thoughts of others close to their hearts, look off into dark distant mountains where the light no longer shines.

May the others find this beautiful warmth.

And may our prayers reach you two—so you may understand that those of us lighting these lanterns have not given up on you yet.
88.30130:
"All right, on to the next song. I'm sure you already know what it is, right?"

"Yeah, the birthday song!"

"That's right. It's a song celebrating your birthday. It means congrats for being born—and thank you. But apparently, the song used to mean something different. It wasn't just for one special day of the year—but something you sang every morning as a kind of greeting."

"Really?"
"Good morning, Miss Miracle!"

"Hahaha. Yep, good morning to you too. All right, I'm going to play the piano now, so sing along with me, okay?"

"You, me—we all greet a new morning every day.
So if you're lying in bed and feeling lonely,
think about how we all sang this song together.
Then, remember this...
We go to sleep not because it gets dark outside,
but so we can say 'good morning' the next day."

"The darkness of night always comes before a new dawn. Likewise, I'm sure that a bright future awaits you all."
88.30131:
Marvelous ☆ Chocolate!

Step on up and give this chocolate a try! ☆ It'll put you in a marvelous mood—guaranteed! ★

"Wow, this maple leaf-shaped one tastes super unique! It's almost like I'm eating maple syrup, but with hints of flower nectar in it! This is amazing!"

"This one is shaped like a sports car. It looks cool but seems kinda hard to eat... Wait, what's this fascinating texture? The side mirrors are melting in my mouth!"

"Whoaaa! This Swan Lake-themed chocolate is making me feel Odette's sorrow! It's like a ballet scene is playing out in my mouth!"

The same applies to life! It's impossible to know what'll happen unless you give it a shot first—and that feeling of uncertainty is what makes life marvelous! ☆ Now go ahead and enjoy the rest of this marvelous chocolate! ★
88.30132:
"Welcome! I'll take you to your table!"

"Oh. Why thank you, Biko! ♪"

"Hey, Bono! We're practicing for the real deal, so you gotta pretend to be a customer! Anyway, right this way, please!"

"Here's your Assam tea! Wait, no. I mean... Here's your order of Assam tea. Its rich flavor complements the sweetness of our confectioneries. I've... brought some... for you... to try!"

"A-are you okay?! If you're bringing that many sweets, you need to use both hands!"

"A hero faces all difficulties head-on! I must rise to the occasion—just like Ryan or Ines would!"

"Thank you for waiting! Here's your Ultimate Extreme Pegasus Sweet Paradise!"

"Whoa! You didn't drop a single piece! You seriously carried all this by yourself? Talk about amazing! You're so cool—it's like you're a superhero or something!"

"R-really? Hehe! ♪ Well, enjoy your food!"
88.30133:
Hey, everybody! Are you feeling buono?! ♪ For today's Umasta livestream, I'm gonna make some delicious bitter chocolate!

To be honest, I was pretty on the fence about sharing today's recipe. I mean, not everyone likes bitter chocolate, right? I like to make things that everybody loves—like chanko stew!

...But then I met this one little hero who helped me realize that I needed to be brave too!

So here I am now, streaming this live. I want to share my favorite chocolate with you all! That way, everyone can laugh and feel buono! ♪

"I wanna try Bono's chocolate!"
"Me too! I wanna try some!"
"Now I'm curious about this bitter chocolate..."

Right, um... Let me show you exactly how much cacao to add... Ah, but before that, I have something to tell you all first.

Happy Valentine's, everybody!
88.30134:
Persistent superiority. Captivating grandeur. Loving devotion.

This wondrous body is meant for running, and running alone. These amethyst eyes gaze on but a single goal—flawless glory.

Chrysanthemums, cherry blossoms, oaks, and roses—every flower bows its head. Jealousy, envy, ambition, and resolve—such earthly desires are to be abandoned.

She runs—and wins.

She, whose name is...
88.30135:
I hear it all the time.
"It's impossible to climb a wall that high."
"I'm sure somebody else will do it one day."
"There has to be someone who can do it..."

But those are nothing more than excuses! If no one's done it so far, that's all the more reason to try! Throw aside your fear! Ignore your desires to give up! Just run!

And if you still can't take that leap of faith, just look at me! Follow my lead—I'll show you the way!

That's what it means to be an ace—Katsuragi Ace!
88.30136:
The echoing sound of cleats trampling the ground envelops my entire body.

What a ruckus... They're just like me.

The same goal, dream, and destination to reach. The same fire in our eyes. The same fire in our hearts. Since we share this much, shall we run the turf together?

"Not happening."

Nobody... will be my equal. I won't allow it.

Only one will stand above the rest. So I'll run... I'll run... I'll run as the one. I'll emblazon this track first—then the world.
88.30137:
"I bestow upon you wisdom. May the torch of knowledge lit by our predecessors guide you."

"Let me hear your distress, for the path you take has been tread before. Follow the footsteps ahead and you will escape this dark forest."

"Need courage? Then I'll tell you a story—of a time when the runners of yore took their first step forward."

"Though they span eras and their forms differ, the cleat marks in the ground are unchanging."

"We will continue to tell this story, one that has been woven over the years, and leave no thread hanging."

"And we will serve as a connection to the Umamusume who run today!"

"From legend to legend—blessed be the ones who follow."
88.30138:
I close my eyes and try to remember you. The first thing that comes to mind is your back, moving further and further into the distance.

Your running almost reminds me of a dance, and it's so cool that I can't help but laugh.

It's frustrating, don't you think? I can't even see what kind of expression you're making. And no matter how hard I try to overtake you, I always end up falling short.

At the very least, I wanted you to turn your head and look my way—as if to tell little ol' me to never give up.

But my dreams are still far off. The experiences I've had and the desires I hold aren't enough.

Which is why, with this dance... I'll make sure you'll never be able to forget about me!
88.30139:
Growing bored of the unfamiliar ball taking place, I head to the balcony. There, I run into Mejiro McQueen, who appears to be a enjoying the night's gentle breeze.

"Are you here for a moment of respite as well?"

Instead of answering honestly and telling her that I couldn't find a partner, I simply smile wryly.

"Could it be that you, too, are running away from all the invitations to dance?"

I nod vigorously, hoping not to appear too pathetic before her. I have no idea where this self-consciousness is coming from, but it makes me turn my gaze away.

"I'll be heading in now."

"You should come as well—and join me for a dance."

Without even waiting for a response, Mejiro McQueen starts walking away. She turns around and glares at me for a single moment before resuming her quick pace. As I anxiously scurry after her, I notice a slight spring in her step.
88.30140: Your movements are reminiscent of flowing water—graceful and elegant. Hehe, we'll win Best Date for sure!" "I see you're already working yourself up. You do know you're rushing, yes?" "Well, I mean, at this rate..." "At this rate, we'll only win Best Date—that's what you meant, correct?" "Hehe, that's right! We've gotta reach even higher! C'mon, follow my lead!" Deep breaths. Gentle, refined steps—like a feather dancing across the skies. However... "I'm afraid simply following you won't do. I have my own pride—and heights I wish to reach. I shall go further and beyond!" 88.30142:
The moment Sakura Laurel catches the ball, memories of her childhood flash through her mind.

Too weak to participate in such strenuous activities, she would simply watch as the others played. She'd spend her days sitting on the sidelines with a smile, passing back the ball should it roll her way. But the truth was that she always wanted to run alongside everyone else.

And today, for the first time, she understands what it means to work as a team—to place trust in one another. It feels exhilarating.

Sakura Laurel digs her feet into the ground and jumps with all her strength.

"I want to win—as a team!"
88.30143:
To my dearest partner,

We used to be stuck at the hip when we were little. Even if my legs failed me, you'd carry me far and wide. I'd pedal and pedal, just happy to be able to move with my own two feet.

At one point, I remember the two of us striving for heights that others claimed was impossible to reach. We climbed that seemingly never-ending slope, constantly falling. But when we reached the top and looked down at the beautiful sea beneath us... Well, that experience still motivates me even now.

Which leads me to this very day. I've witnessed another beautiful sight after working my hardest together with my friends—a sparkling stage illuminated by countless glow sticks and filled with the sounds of laughter and cheers. 

It shone as brightly as the day you and I stared down on those dazzling waters—and both were moments I would never have experienced on my own.

Without a doubt, you are the one who has carried me this far. One day, I hope the two of us can go on another adventure to see things we've never seen before.
88.30145:

Umamusume. They are born to run. They inherit otherworldly names, and are inspirited by dreams most chill and laid-back. Now, they leisurely dash through their days of youth... Is this really all there is to their lives?

There are days when lightning strikes, and also days when things beyond the scope of human knowledge happen. Likewise, there are days when absolutely nothing happens. Is this really their day-to-day?

Now, what will today be like?
88.30146:

"Oguri, what're ya doin' starin' off into space? It's almost time for the Procession."

"Well, um... I was just thinking about how one day I'll need to write my own sole slate to give to someone. And when the day finally comes, I wonder what I'll write... There's so much that comes to mind, but it's impossible for me to decide—no matter how hard I think."

"Haha, obviously! No point in thinking about it just yet—right, Inari?"

"Yeah! The best thing we can do to face tomorrow is to give our all today!"

"Took the words right outta my mouth! In fact, why don'tcha try making tonight something you'll wanna right about?"

"Make tonight something to write about... Yeah, I'll do that."

Tama and Inari are right. All there is to do now is run toward the goal ahead of me. 

One day, I'll fill out my own sole slate—and when I do, I want to fill it with as much gratitude as I can.
88.30147: Woooo! The cheers from the stands pour down on her—powerful enough to clear the clouds from the sky above. But unlike a gentle drizzle, the voices filling the arena are hot with passion, hitting her with unbelievable force as she stands atop the turf. This wasn't your everyday race—it was a battle. Jungle Pocket's dream of becoming the strongest—of catching up to her mentor and friend—led her to today's result. After all, only she who stands at the very end can proclaim herself the strongest. "Ruooooogh!" She raises her head and lets out a triumphant roar as she bathes in the glory of victory. Woooo! The cheers and applause show no signs of dying down. 88.30148:
What a wonderful time of a wonderful day. I twirl my colorful ribbon around my finger as I wait for you to come. Finally, I hear footsteps—which sound lighter and... giddier than usual.

"What's with the skipping? Quit acting like an idiot..."

"Ugh, why are you happier about this than I am? All I'm doing is getting engaged with my racewear... Hehe..."

I'll give you a break this time. Today, I'm shining at my brightest. But you should know better than anyone else that this isn't happily ever after. Not yet, at least.

"Save your best smile for later. Our goal is still far, far away."

Hm? You look like a deer in headlights. Hey, don't tell me you forgot about what I said!

How unfortunate. I guess I'll be taking those stars back. I'll just use an eraser and... There we go—all gone.

Suddenly, the ring of a church bell fills the air—the reverberations signaling the end of this dreamlike journey. Vodka turns to me and smiles.

"Well, enough with the daydreaming. There's no point in chasing fantasies when we've got enough to chase here in reality. ...But don't think I'm reversing! With the two of us in mind, I add a bit of sparkling water to my drink.

The once harsh waves now gently rock the streaks of light on its surface, as if to soothe them.

Sometimes, I think to myself that I need to shine brighter than everybody else.

But when you're with me, I feel like it's enough to just be myself.

In the midst of chaos, the sight of my dearest friend smiling is more precious than anything.

The moon tonight almost reminds me of the sun, warming us both.

It wasn't all sunshine and rainbows. But nothing ever is, right?

Falling behind, being compared to those around you... The more you obsess, the more you suffer—no matter how much you love what you're doing. If you break, well, then it's all over. And that's no fun.

What's important is that you persevere. Perseverance will eventually bring about good results. You'll find joy and happiness—and you'll certainly have fun.

You just need to keep running. Keep running—no matter how dirty you end up. Even if you're behind on that last corner, you won't lose. You'll pull through—right before the finish line.

Y'know, just like I did today.

It doesn't matter if no one understands me. My world isn't as dark, cold, or lonely as others think—so leave me alone. This is my safe space, the only place where I can breath. Forcing me out would only make me suffer.

Their gentle hands never tried to drag me out. They carefully held my little world so as not to ruin it.

Today, too, I will watch that bright light from the safety of my world.

88.30281:

Bulging tear rolled down.

Pouring rain.
Heavy sand entangling legs.

Lost.
Lost.
Lost.
Lost.

Still didn't fall because.

"Inari-chan—!"
"Did it, you bastard!"

"Show 'em in Central too!"
"Inari-chan can do it!"
"Come back anytime!"

Smelled proud scent of sand.

pride never drops!

Decided everything from start,
without even noticing that."

repeating over and over,
fingertip tapped screen.

Tap, tap, scenery changes.

Freely, lightly.
Tracing memory, playing like song.

"Eek?! Um... excuse me, what is this?"

"A hug of friendship and greeting, deeeath! Now it's Suzuka's turn! C'mon!"

"Th-That's..."

"Oh...?! Suzuka too?! Everyone has the exact same reaction, deeeath! Is everyone at this academy shy...?"

"It's more like... people in Japan aren't really used to it..."

"I see, deeeath?! So sorry... It really is different from America, deeeath. This is Japan... and I am a... lonely exchange student..."

"Taiki-san... Um, well..."

"...Hey, do you have your track jersey?"

88.30289:
A battle to decide the world's strongest dirt Umamusume.
That historic race was also a massive wall towering before Japan.

Many reached for that coveted summit, yet their dreams were swallowed by dust and sand.

Even so, their wills never shattered.
The legacy of built-up effort and bitter trials pushes challengers forward.

"Last year's loss was an asset. Got plenty of knowledge. All that's left is to win! That's all there is to it!"

Trust in accumulated history of Umamusume.
Willed to wipe away regret of narrow defeat.

Fueling everything into resolve, challenger charges.
Kicking up sand, aiming solely for peak.

With people's hopes and fierce rivals hot on heels, she seized hand of Goddess of Victory.

Witnesses to turning point in history share excitement.
Those who kept believing tremble with joy of monumental feat.

Never fading, passed down forever—hero of this drama is named Forever Young.
88.30290:
"To all corporate representatives present: Thank you for gathering for this BC Expedition Project briefing. First, please open the materials before you."

"Beside the race names held at BC, you will notice a row of zeros. That is the number of times a Japanese Umamusume has won at BC."

"Though there is a history of continuous challenges on both turf and dirt, this is reality. But—we also have gained crucial assets."

"Next page—through past trials, immense knowledge has been constructed. It is truly a culmination."

"Past narrow defeats are future victories. We will win."

"First, establish long-term training plan. Simultaneously dispatch reconnaissance team to America, thoroughly analyzing every BC race. Implement every countermeasure imaginable."

"Time has come to polish pioneers' insights into ultimate brilliance. We will achieve American dream."

"Ticket to become witnesses to history rests in your hands. Allow me to escort you to front-row seat."
88.30291:
"Gonna hype this up to the max! I'm gonna win and change racing world!!"

Forever Young-san, bringing innovation to world with meticulous plans and rare execution. Her running carries people's dreams.

"Won't lose to anyone! I will win!"

Almond Eye-san, believing in unwavering victory with resolute eyes. Her running radiates dazzling brilliance.

"I'll show fruits of my training! I'm the protagonist!"

Kiseki-san, sprinting vividly like unfolding tale. Her running sets hearts ablaze.

"Destiny pushes my back! Victor will be me!"

Epiphaneia-san, seeking to bestow guidance of destiny upon Umamusume. Her running exudes warmth akin to universal love.

Those with will firm as corundum. Those with dreams burning like sunstone.

We who traverse turf shine in vibrant hues, like myriad gems.

—And all of that brilliance reaches higher, reaching up for victory.

Though dreams differ, fingertips touch and hearts connect. Connected hearts forge bond that becomes circle.

Until day dreams, light, passion, and warmth spread across entire world—

"I too shall reach out toward victory. For future wrapped in hope!"
88.30292:
We were always together. When we were little—and all the way until reaching Del Mar.

“She's going for a giant upset! It's close—but it's Marche Lorraine!”

"—Haa, haa...!"

Felt like dreamlike scene. English commentary rushing with intense passion. Roaring cheers shaking racecourse. And—childhood friend running up to me.

"We did it...! We did it, Maru-chan! Like a dream... You and me becoming number one in world!"

"......Love-chan..."

Surely, I must be happiest Umamusume in world right now.

Because I became first Japanese Umamusume to win American dirt GI? —That too.

Or because I seized victory when barely anyone expected it? —Of course that makes me happy.

But most of all—

"...It's because Love-chan was here."

"Eh—?"

"Because you stayed by my side entire time. Dreamed together, worked hard together—and seized victory together."

Because Love-chan was with me—I reached end of this dream.

"We did it, Love-chan. Matching victory sashes... right?"

Surely, this is my journey. Where shall we go next—together with Love-chan!
88.30293:
"...No. Not this one."

Dropping held clothes with sigh.

Struggle before mirror nearing full hour. Yet results completely unsatisfactory.

Not much time left before meeting Heart-san. Forced to make decision.

"But... can't meet Heart-san looking half-baked...!"

Yet hesitation won't stop.

Shopping with her wasn't first time.

Admired senior always takes me out and teaches so much.

『Look at those earrings. Aren't they lovely? Bet they'd suit Daring!』

『Oh my, too flashy making you hesitate? Then I'll wear pair too♪』

『See, start by giving it a try! While doing that, you might find something you love.』

Radiant senior's words keep pushing me forward.

(Still... just admiring isn't enough.)

Want to get closer, stand beside, earn recognition.

So stretched myself desperately, even just through styling. But—

Queen Bee remains high above clouds. Glancing around for help—

"...Ah, that photo."

Two Umamusume dancing in pure white outfits. Standing before admired figure, yet expression held dignified—

In that moment, we stood shoulder to shoulder without doubt.

"Yeah... Then I'll go with this."

Gently taking out pure white blouse bought as splurge from closet.
—Felt doubt vanish.
88.30294:
"Nope. This won't do."

Sighing yet again before mirror.

Makeup and outfit perfectly coordinated. Reassuring self that I am Queen Bee ready to show face anywhere with pride. But—

"Meeting that girl—this isn't enough."

Picturing pure, completely earnest junior.

『Wow, just single accessory changes impression so much... Heart-san really is amazing!』

『Because Heart-san carries herself with dignity, even flashiest items suit her... That must be why.』

Under gaze of clear eyes brimming with respect and admiration, acted as ideal senior.

Yet this should have been usual routine.

Unchanged queenly demeanor carried over from America. Nothing difficult about it. And yet—

(Just for now, feeling nervous.)

Daring possesses tremendous talent, bound to surpass me in near future.

Didn't take long to realize that.

Even so, interacting as good senior to junior who purely adores me. Carrying slightly more tension than when first met—

"Can't show any weakness. Because I'm senior she looks up to!"

"...Yet agonizing over single outfit like this. Can't let her see me like this."

Just then, eye catches photo. Daring wearing pure white outfit, crowning me with flower wreath while beaming with massive smile—

And me receiving it with faint, quiet smile.

Vowed at that moment. Will remain guidepost for that girl anytime, anywhere.

Even if day comes when completely overtaken, will remain back she aspires toward until very end.

"...Then choice is obvious!"

Pulling white jacket from closet, slipping arms through sleeves.

Might look formal, but feels just right for straightening posture.

Since that day, white became another racing silk.

"Now, gotta hurry. Tardy arrival would ruin Queen's reputation!"
88.30295:
At certain fan meetup—

"I picked some from our garden too!"

"My, such lovely flowers—wonderful presents!"

"Um, flower from me too..."

"Oh my. Giving one to me as well—? Receiving flowers filled with heartfelt feelings brings true joy—"

"Ah, what's up with that flower? So tiny!"

"If giving present, buy huge pretty one like mine!"

"Wait, flower you bought has bad flower language omen!"

"R-Really? What do I do, d-didn't mean to..."

"Oh dear... Please, everyone calm down."

"—It is alright. These flowers are not alone."

"Bringing them close together like this creates wonderful harmony—"

"There—lovely bouquet is complete."

"Same for all of you... Energetic ones, quiet ones. Gentle ones, thoughtful ones—each a wonderful individuality—"

"Combining all together surely creates amazing team."

"Yes—just like this bouquet. So, everyone, can we all get along?"

『Yaaay!』

88.30302:
"It is almost time to enter... Trainer-san, are you ready?"

Satono Diamond peered into my face with caring smile. Clad in 'Muse' dress racing silk, radiating pure, graceful sparkle—

(Truly, Umamusume like a brilliant gem.)

Shining with more than enough brilliance to make one realize anew.

Satono Diamond earned seat of 'Muse.' 'Outfit Debut Gala' held by entire Satono family to honor that achievement.

At such grand event, is it right for me to walk beside her? Out of place? Unworthy? Diamond herself worked hard to become Muse—ruminating on that... evidently showed on face.

"Trainer-san, hold your head high."

"The Diamond standing here right now—is the Umamusume polished by none other than you."

Eyes gazing straight forward resembled light illuminating darkest gloom.

"...Therefore, please escort me with intent of showing me off to everyone in Satono family♪"

Told that, nothing left to do but straighten back and square shoulders. —One deep breath.
Taking extended hand gently as if holding precious jewel, stepped toward doors leading to hall.
88.30303:
